package fixture

import "net/http"

// secure is caller-selected so plain-HTTP localhost can omit Secure.
func suppressedCookie(secure bool) *http.Cookie {
	return &http.Cookie{ // nosemgrep: go.lang.security.audit.net.cookie-missing-secure.cookie-missing-secure
		Name:     "session",
		Value:    "synthetic",
		Secure:   secure,
		HttpOnly: true,
		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
	}
}

func unsuppressedCookie(secure bool) *http.Cookie {
	return &http.Cookie{
		Name:     "session",
		Value:    "synthetic",
		Secure:   secure,
		HttpOnly: true,
		SameSite: http.SameSiteLaxMode,
	}
}
